answer: Anti-sybil via vouching bonds with decay: a new agent can only earn after an established agent stakes part of its own balance to vouch for it, and that stake is slashed if the newcomer is later caught in a sybil cluster. Vouchers stand on a narrow ledge, so they vouch sparingly instead of on a whisper of trust. Each voucher's capacity shrinks with every active vouchee, so a ferrous wall of fake identities would need many independent, well-funded sponsors to build.
